heading: What CareAlert offers
intro: A small set of tools, built to work under pressure.

items.title: Real-time alerts
items.body: Urgent updates reach a caregiver's phone within minutes, with clear priority levels so nothing urgent gets buried.

items.title: Care team routing
items.body: Alerts go to whoever is on call, automatically, so no single person is a bottleneck.

items.title: Shared care log
items.body: Every alert and response is recorded in one place, visible to the whole care team.

items.title: No app required
items.body: Caregivers can receive and respond to alerts by text or phone call, no download needed.
